bio: Just a short walk from York’s iconic Minster, No. 1 York is a Grade II listed Regency townhouse, with sash windows, high ceilings and a sweeping central staircase.  The Afternoon Tea embraces the noble tradition, with playful twists on the classics. The menu features dainty sandwiches, scones, cakes and pork pies, paired with local loose leaf fruit teas or the classic English Breakfast. For something extra special, why not add a glass of English sparkling wine!  Afternoon Tea at No.1 is hosted in The Marmalade Lounge. Bask in the glow of yellow and mustard tones, obscurely intriguing artwork and geometric patterns. The Marmalade Lounge has a roaring fire in the winter.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 12:30pm to 5pm and costs £30 per person, or £38 per person with a glass of English Sparkling wine.
